author: Sabine Hossenfelder
description:
Try out the visual possibilities of AI on Higgsfield:  https://higgsfield.ai?fpr=sabine-dc6d6d

There are new rumours that today's AI might be conscious, and this time it's not just talk. Anthropic says it found a hidden part of Claude that works like an internal notepad, one it can use to reason without revealing it. Not everyone's convinced. And I think most of these papers are asking the wrong question entirely. Let's take a look.

Paper: https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2512.12802
